extra: State-machine tournament, generation 2 (Handoff 9.4). The two generation-1 survivors (clock3, clock2) plus eight bred around them: the lane opening at rounds 3, 5 and 6; clock3 with the objective band shortened; two crossovers of a lane opening with the income and tower rules; and two unrelated designs, a siege-from-round-1 machine that only wards when two champions down, and a machine that opens on a fight.

Anchors are no longer tiers in the pool: half the games put T2_sieger or T2_search in one seat against a drawn machine, so each machine meets each anchor about 12 times and the two anchors 24 times pooled. Rank on the lower confidence bound (9d), read the against-anchor columns.

What would settle it: a machine whose lower bound clears the pure sieger's point estimate says a laning opening (or something else) is real; a second generation with nothing clearing it says the field is the sieger, and champion balance can be read against it.
